name: OpenRLHF
summary: Apache-2.0 high-performance RLHF / post-training framework built on Ray, with support for multiple reward and policy-optimization recipes.
description: Established open-source RLHF toolkit (OpenRLHF/OpenRLHF; not archived; not a 2026 launch). GitHub license Apache-2.0. PyPI openrlhf 0.11.2 and docs https://openrlhf.readthedocs.io/ verified 2026-11-11. Training requires substantial GPU resources; model licenses and cluster costs are separate from the framework.

agent_access.notes: Python package: pip install openrlhf. Distributed GPU setup is documented separately.
